- Scabies treatment usually requires applying the cream to the entire body (neck down, often including scalp/face in older adults), leaving it on for 8–14 hours, then washing off.
- Close contacts and shared bedding/clothing must be treated simultaneously to prevent reinfestation.
- Itching may persist for 2–4 weeks after successful treatment due to an allergic reaction to dead mites; this does not mean the treatment failed.
